method.inventory: All 2004 frozen file hashes checked, all 138 current runtime source/test/fixture paths matched the frozen inventory, and final scope hashes rechecked. Hashing does not count as semantic reading.
method.inheritance: 128 unchanged files inherit exact prior per-file semantics, tests and declared limits from v232-final-runtime.json. Previous source dabbc561... is not silently rebound: removed in-place conversion/consent paths are excluded and 10 changed/new files are separately reviewed.
method.currentReading: Complete current thread-conversion, providers, thread-activity, helper transport/inspection and changed dedicated test modules; complete service and service-test diff plus current conversion/resume/turn, admission, notifications, sessions, history and live-list integration boundaries. No claim that every unchanged test was reread.
method.functionalFlow: Explicit confirmed conversion requires a loaded idle source, matching current provider, allowed local environment and no active goal/queue. Source pending spans inspection, native close, fresh post-close witness, native new-target creation, copy, target-only repair, settings restore/verification and publication. New target pending blocks ordinary resume/input while owned.
method.historyAndSettings: Original provider/title/raw bytes remain unchanged from the native post-close witness. Independent paginated target preserves the official target header and source nonheader records; helper-only target repair, metadata/settings, collaboration, permissions, saved tier/summary and exact cwd/project/environment are verified. Original bad formats remain original, with explicit limits rather than silently rewriting source.
method.deliveryAndRecovery: Positive native ACK marks write acceptance before response parsing or bookkeeping. Later capture/capacity/uncertainty failures remain unknown with a distinct target identity when known; failed source-ID reuse is not advertised as a new target. Helper publication unknown is not replayed. Pre-dispatch reservation failure remains not_sent. Target repair has one production orchestration path.
method.adjacentScope: Prior full session/history/activity/queue/goals/attachments/permissions/terminal/workspace/subagent/listing semantics remain bound by unchanged bytes; current checks focus on conversion dependencies, history invalidation, model capabilities, owner/pending gates and removed-code references. Agent-list relation-filter suspicion remains disproved by the earlier pinned native evidence.
method.independence: Runtime source changes authored by runtime agent. This reviewer authored Python helper changes, which are outside this independent runtime approval and separately reviewed by root in v232-copy-control-review.json. No claim of self-independent helper approval.
method.validation: Reviewed final source-bound raw Vitest evidence and test assertions; no tests, full suite, typecheck, browser, network freshness, remote changes or inference executed during this final audit closure.

resolvedObservations.resolution: Accepted native creation followed by bounded activity bookkeeping failure cannot become not_sent; uncertainty callback failure is contained with global fallback. Real ThreadActivity maximum=1 regression plus positive adapter ACK without beforeWrite passed.

Created, resumed and final verified target must preserve exact source project/environment identity and cwd; empty versus default local selection is distinct. Schema-valid mismatches reject publication as unknown; no assertion that actual CLI emitted such a mismatch.

Existing native close/history invalidation already sets fresh=false. Explicit publish false is defensive clarity; actual unread copied history returns history_incomplete/not_sent. Not counted as an observed product bug.
Original-thread repair, provider-switch/consent module and unreleased backup-store/read/abandon orchestration removed. Current conversion creates a separate new target and never repairs original.
Pinned native ancestor relation filter intentionally bypasses default-provider filtering; prior real metadata regression and exact unchanged workflows bytes retained.

validation.fullSuite: not run or claimed by this report
validation.nativeScope: Official 0.164.0 in isolated HOME with strict loopback Responses. Five local model requests exercise original/new continuation; conversion itself sends zero. Native test covers writer lock, post-close source bytes/provider/title, compacted paired metadata, source/target pending, unread history gate and new-target continuation after original deletion/restart. No paid provider or external MCP.

evidence.kind: prior full runtime semantic/depth record; 128 unchanged bytes inherited
final author 10-file binding and retained failed attempts
independent root approval of helper/control, not self-review
helper author contract, Windows/Linux/long-history measurements with explicit skips/limits
prior falsified agent-list concern; immutable evidence
single parent-run current source-bound MCP check; not repeated

skipped: No repeated full test run, remote operation or public MCP check; those are separate gates.
No repeated full-body read of the 128 unchanged files; prior exact-byte per-file evidence is retained explicitly.
limits: This clean result applies to runtime source/test scope at the named freeze; it is not a whole-repository/full-CI/deployment approval.

Conversion requires a loaded local independent paginated source. Legacy/compressed/inherited/opaque unsupported conversion fails before unload; ordinary loading is not rewritten or globally forbidden.
Source byte invariance begins after normal native close flush. The operation does not roll back later filesystem/tool side effects or copy goal/queue databases.
Preserved public summaries are independent displayed events; no promise that a summary present only inside removed reasoning survives.

Long-history bounds/performance are inherited from separately bound helper evidence, not a native/UI benchmark here. Conversion deadline and unknown handling do not guarantee successful completion for every 1GiB input.

Final 98-pass evidence is targeted Windows/local-native testing, not cross-platform CI; helper Linux evidence separately reports 47 pass/1 Windows-only skip. Earlier failed parameter identity/expected-error attempts remain in author evidence and are not overwritten.
